title: The Loose Extraction
author: Lior Yarrow
blurb: Noor Lockridge, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
